scripts.compose:up: docker image prune -f && cd ../../../../release && docker compose  -f container-apps/exm-data-store-prisma/store-prisma/docker-compose.yml up
scripts.compose:stop: docker image prune -f && cd ../../../../release && docker compose  -f container-apps/exm-data-store-prisma/store-prisma/docker-compose.yml stop
scripts.gen:down-script: prisma migrate diff --from-schema-datamodel prisma/schema.prisma --to-schema-datasource prisma/schema.prisma --script > down.sql
scripts.build:prisma:v6: pnpm run prisma:generate && bash ../../../../build-script/container/build-prisma.sh && tsup --config ../../../../tsup.lib.config.ts && bash ../../../../build-script/container/build-prisma-v6.sh
scripts.release: pnpm run build && cd ../../../../ && bash build-script/container/release-prisma-liquibase-migration.sh scope-webapi exm-data store-prisma
